en_US: Are you raising different kinds of
Pokémon?
If you only have the same type of
Pokémon, you’ll have a hard time
against types it’s weak to.
Hi, are you the flirty type?
I’m asking you this to make a point.
I teach at the Trainers’ School,
and I’d like to give you a lesson.
But before I do, I’d like you to
have this TM.
You know how Pokémon have genders?
Like, there are males and females?
Well, this TM holds the move Power
Gem, a Rock-type special attack.
It fires a ray of light that sparkles
as if it were made of gemstones.
You also probably know this, but a
TM can be used over and over.
Teach it to as many Pokémon as
you like.
Floaroma Town
